heroText: Ísafjörður works best as a base in Iceland when you anchor days around Old town, Westfjords Heritage Museum and Naustahvilft. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Ísafjörður Airport (IFJ) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.label: 9th century
history.text: According to the Landnámabók (the book of settlement), Skutulsfjörður was first settled by Helgi Magri Hrólfsson in the 9th century.

history.label: 16th century
history.text: In the 16th century, the town grew as it became a trading post for foreign merchants.

history.label: 18th century
history.text: The former Danish trading post Neðstikaupstaður, established in the 18th century, contains the oldest collection of timber frame houses in Iceland.
The town of Ísafjörður was granted municipal status in 1786.

The partly one-lane Vestfjarðagöng (Vestfirðir Tunnel), completed in 1996, leads to the towns of Flateyri and Suðureyri, and to the western parts of the Westfjords. Ísafjörður has an airport with regular flights to Reykjavík.

A university center, Háskólasetur Vestfjarða, which acts as a distance learning center for the 7,000 residents of the Westfjords as well as provides graduate education and research on coastal issues, was established in March 2005.
